newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Astra to issue 400 bln rph bond in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Astra to issue 400 bln rph bond in 1997.

text.p: Indonesian automotive maker PT Astra International will issue a 400-billion rupiah bond in 1997, a company official said on Thursday.
The official, who declined to be identified, said Astra had not yet decided on the date for the bond issue.
The official said the bonds will mature in five years, but added that no decision had been made yet on the interest rate.
Proceeds will be used to refinance the company's short-term debts, the official said, declining to give further details.
